Ivy (CS): FYI Minnow preview (wave F) stalled on SCIM/SSO mapping. PM says they cant invite seats until attributes map. renewal flagged as 'watch' if staging blocked >7 days.
Sam (Enablement): we can run a 20m 'staging unblock' session to get them running with a scoped token and show attribute mapping steps.
Diego (SolutionsEng): 20m ok. need their SCIM mapping file + IdP logs beforehand. asked for them yesterday, not received. also will prepare a quick mapping checklist and a sample mapping JSON.
Ivy (CS): i'll nudge PM and offer a screenshot guide. i'll mention a temporary scoped org option to keep product validation moving. :memo:
onboard-bot: Temporary sandbox org: https://redwood.example/orgs/minnow-sandbox - seats:4 - token: https://redwood.example/tokens/minnow-temp-77 - expires 2024-09-10T12:00Z. Audit logging enabled.
Sam (Enablement): i'll include a one-question pulse at the end: "Were you able to execute your top-3 flows? yes/no" and a 1-click micro-survey. will add to invite.
Diego (SolutionsEng): i'll add a pinned note about model suggestions for low-cost eval (small-llm-lite) and a rollback step: revoke token + reprovision.
Ivy (CS): onboard-bot, please create invite for Wed 2024-08-28 14:00 UTC  attendees: Ivy (CS), Sam (Enablement), Diego (SolutionsEng), Minnow PM.
onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: Wed 2024-08-28 14:00-14:20 UTC - "Minnow wave F: staging unblock (20m)" - Join: https://meet.redwood/example/mnfw
Sam (Enablement): agenda: 1) quick SCIM mapping triage (7m), 2) temp token + sandbox walkthrough (8m), 3) run 3 core flows + pulse (5m).
Ivy (CS): next steps: 1) Ivy nudge PM for mapping file + logs (ASAP). 2) Sam prep invite + micro-survey + 1-slide quickstart (Mon EOD). 3) Diego prepare mapping checklist + model note (Mon EOD). 4) Offer temp sandbox during session if mapping still blocked.
Diego (SolutionsEng): ack.
Sam (Enablement): ack.
Ivy (CS): I'll log this as a renewal-mitigation touch and CC the AM. ping here if PM uploads artifacts and i'll forward. :thumbsup:
